ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly biased towards low-intensity (black) pixels; high-intensity (white) pixels represent approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips (coordinates: top-left and top-right extremities). A high-contrast cluster of parallel linear marks is situated in the central-left lobe. Fine white speckling is distributed across the lower-central region above the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher frequency and amplitude peaks compared to the relatively smoother segments of the left lobe's inner trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual white circular marks consistent with old attachment sites across the lower fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of four prominent, roughly parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) on the mid-left lobe. Two shorter, less defined linear marks are visible on the upper-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips.
